name: Scarlet Crusade
summary: Across Tirisfal Glades and the Plaguelands, crimson banners mark the Scarlet Crusade's war on the undead. The crusaders rose from the broken Knights of the Silver Hand to reclaim Lordaeron. Paranoia blinds them to anyone beyond their ranks, whom they brand plague carriers and shoot on sight.

sections.title: Rise from the Ashes
sections.body:
After Prince Arthas betrayed Lordaeron and murdered King Terenas Menethil II, the Order of the Silver Hand broke apart. Surviving paladins and priests rallied around leaders such as Alexandros Mograine, saidan dathrohan, and General Abbendis.

They gathered at Hearthglen and Tyr's Hand to reclaim their ruined homeland, then swore to burn away the undead scourge with holy fire. As the war dragged on, tragedy and suspicion took hold. Their desperate resistance hardened into an unyielding, xenophobic crusade.

sections.title: The Great Schism
sections.body:
As the Crusade's teachings hardened into madness, moderate commanders recoiled. Lord Maxwell Tyrosus and his followers argued that reclaiming the north required allies across Azeroth, and sought aid from dwarves, gnomes, and night elves. The zealots refused, so Tyrosus and other disillusioned knights left to form the Argent Dawn, devoted to the Holy Light's pure and inclusive tenets.

The Scarlet Crusade made the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades its center of power. There, they slaughter travelers and refugees, convinced that all who walk the Plaguelands carry the Scourge's contagion.

sections.title: A Puppet in Crimson
sections.body:
The Scarlet Crusade's descent into butchery was not entirely its own. During an assault on Stratholme, Grand Crusader saidan dathrohan became separated from his men. The dreadlord Balnazzar quietly murdered him, took possession of his corpse, and seized direct control of the Scarlet ranks.

Balnazzar fed their paranoia and arranged for Highlord alexandros mograine to be murdered through the jealousy of his son renault. Beneath speeches of purity and righteous fury, the crusaders unknowingly serve the demonic darkness they believe the Light commands them to destroy.

faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade hostile to everyone?
aliases: why does scarlet crusade attack me
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade's paranoia grew after Lordaeron fell. They believe anyone who has spent time in northern Lordaeron without their order's cleansing carries the plague of undeath, whether openly or in wait. To preserve their vision of pure humanity, they execute outsiders on sight.

faq.q: Where did the Scarlet Crusade come from?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade arose from surviving knights and priests of the Knights of the Silver Hand after Lordaeron fell during the Third War. They regrouped at Hearthglen and the Scarlet Monastery under leaders such as Saidan Dathrohan and Alexandros Mograine. They pledged to eradicate the Scourge by any means.

faq.q: How is the Scarlet Crusade different from the Argent Dawn?
aliases: difference between scarlet and argent dawn
faq.answer: Both orders broke from the original Silver Hand. The Argent Dawn welcomes all races and follows the Light's compassionate virtues. The Scarlet Crusade became a fanatical, human-supremacist cult that massacres refugees and travelers in the name of holy cleansing.

faq.q: Where are the Scarlet Crusade's main bases located?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Monastery in northeastern Tirisfal Glades is the Crusade's chief stronghold. They also control Hearthglen in the Western Plaguelands, Tyr's Hand in the east, and the Scarlet Bastion in Stratholme's ruins. Scout towers stand across the region.

faq.q: Who actually leads the Scarlet Crusade?
aliases: who is leader of scarlet crusade
faq.answer: Grand Crusader Saidan Dathrohan appears to command the Crusade from Stratholme. High Inquisitor Whitemane and Scarlet Commander Mograine support him at the Monastery.

faq.q: Can the Scarlet Crusaders still use the Holy Light if they are evil?
aliases: why can scarlets use the light
faq.answer: Yes. The Light answers absolute conviction and faith, not moral goodness. The crusaders believe their brutal cause is pure and just, and that belief lets them wield holy wrath despite their cruelty.

angles.text: As a paladin, you can see how the Scarlet Crusade twists the Silver Hand's teachings. Righteous conviction without humility or compassion can become tyranny.
As an undead, you face the Scarlet Crusade as the Forsaken's nearest living enemy. They contest Tirisfal Glades' borders and hunt undead who have escaped the Lich King's grasp.
As an Alliance member, you may wear Lordaeron's armor and speak its tongue, but the Scarlet Crusade considers the modern Alliance compromised. They execute Alliance emissaries without hesitation.
As a priest, you can see how faith loses its bounds without moral restraint. The Crusade's followers use holy scripture to justify ruthless inquisitions and village purges.
